parameters.content:
## LS-06 Launch critical path
**Weekdays 13:00 UTC.** For every colorway, counts back from the launch date: PP sample approved (T-90, Production), licensor approval (T-75, licensed prints only), compliance passed (T-60, Compliance & Integrity), photography delivered (T-30, Photography), synced to ERP (T-21, Systems).

1. Writes status back to **Colorways**, only fields that changed (no changes = no API calls)
2. Snapshots every milestone to `audit.colorway_milestones` (days-per-stage SQL)
3. ONE Slack digest grouped by team, not one ping per colorway

Lead times live in `shared/product_model.json`.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO audit.colorway_milestones
  (run_id, colorway_record_id, colorway_name, sku_base, launch_date, milestone, owner_team, due_date, completed_on, status, days_late)
SELECT $1, r.colorway_record_id, r.colorway_name, r.sku_base, r.launch_date::date, r.milestone, r.owner_team,
       r.due_date::date, r.completed_on::date, r.status, r.days_late
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r(colorway_record_id text, colorway_name text, sku_base text, launch_date text,
     milestone text, owner_team text, due_date text, completed_on text, status text, days_late int);
